text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe's state Department of National Parks and Wildlife Management has cut by half entry, accommodation and other fees it charges at its facilities following protests by the southern African country's tourism industry chiefs who said the high fees would hurt the sector.
The fees were increased up to tenfold last month as the department, stripped of most of its government budget, battled to make up the gap.

- At least 13 people were killed and 135 others injured in road accidents in some parts of Zimbabwe last weekend, police reported on Monday. But they said the figures were provisional as other centres had yet to report.
